nimesarenes.name: Arènes de Nîmes
nimesarenes.slogan: Two thousand years of crowds, still roaring on feria nights.
nimesarenes.line: Its façade has two levels of 60 arcades, and it has been a bullring since 1863.

pontdugard.name: Pont du Gard
pontdugard.slogan: Three tiers of golden stone, laid without a drop of mortar.
pontdugard.line: Unspeakably imposing, and nothing could well be more Roman.

maisoncarreenimes.name: Maison Carrée
maisoncarreenimes.slogan: A Roman temple so whole that Jefferson borrowed its face.
maisoncarreenimes.line: Dedicated to Augustus's grandsons Gaius and Lucius, it inspired Thomas Jefferson's Virginia State Capitol.

aiguesmortesramparts.name: Ramparts of Aigues-Mortes
aiguesmortesramparts.slogan: A walled town floating between salt pans and sea.
aiguesmortesramparts.line: From these walls Louis IX sailed for the Seventh Crusade in 1248, and again in 1270.

jardinsfontainenimes.name: Jardins de la Fontaine
jardinsfontainenimes.slogan: Shady terraces built around a spring older than Rome.
jardinsfontainenimes.line: Laid out in 1745-1755 over the Roman Augusteum, the gardens keep only Diana's temple of the ancient complex.
